title: OB_material glTF material extension
description: meshes.md 3.8: informative; what a draw range draws with. The engine ignores it; the mesh import path (meshes.md 4.5) reads it. The extension's version is in the glTF root object: #/$defs/root.

light_material.description: A light material's bare hash (conventions.md 6.6), as in OB_solid.light_materials.

root.description: meshes.md 3.1: the extension's entry in the glTF root object's extensions, once per file: the lowest version of the extension that reads the file (versioning.md 1, 2.1).
